title: Add Rating Stars
content: Create star rating component with interactive stars. Container: flex items-center gap-1. Stars: 5 Star icons from lucide-react. Filled state: fill-yellow-400 text-yellow-400. Empty state: text-gray-300. Hover preview: show tentative rating on hover. Click to set rating. Half-star support optional with clip-path. Display mode (read-only) vs input mode. Show numeric value beside stars. Different sizes: sm (w-4 h-4), md (w-5 h-5), lg (w-6 h-6). Accessible with keyboard (arrow keys to change rating).

variants.simple: Create a star rating component for reviews and feedback.
variants.detailed: Create star rating component with interactive stars. Container: flex items-center gap-1. Stars: 5 Star icons from lucide-react. Filled state: fill-yellow-400 text-yellow-400. Empty state: text-gray-300. Hover preview: show tentative rating on hover. Click to set rating. Half-star support optional with clip-path. Display mode (read-only) vs input mode. Show numeric value beside stars. Different sizes: sm (w-4 h-4), md (w-5 h-5), lg (w-6 h-6). Accessible with keyboard (arrow keys to change rating).
variants.advanced: Create accessible star rating component with full interaction support. Container: inline-flex items-center gap-0.5. Star component: button type="button" for each star, using Star icon from lucide-react. States: empty (text-gray-300), filled (text-yellow-400 fill-yellow-400), hover preview (text-yellow-300 fill-yellow-300). Half-star implementation: each star split into two click zones (left = x.5, right = x.0), visual half using CSS clip-path or two overlapping icons. Hover behavior: show preview rating from hovered star leftward. Click: set rating, optionally allow clearing by clicking current rating. Read-only mode: no hover effects, no buttons, just display. Sizes: sm (w-4 h-4 gap-0.5), md (w-5 h-5 gap-1), lg (w-6 h-6 gap-1). Numeric display: optional text showing "4.5 out of 5" or just "4.5". Review count: optional "(123 reviews)" text with link. Accessibility: role="radiogroup" on container, role="radio" on each star, aria-checked, aria-label="Rate X out of 5 stars". Keyboard: tab to focus, arrow keys to change rating, Enter/Space to confirm. Touch: larger touch targets on mobile. Animation: scale-110 on hover/focus, smooth color transition. Props: value, onChange, max (default 5), allowHalf, readOnly, size, showValue, disabled. Custom icons: allow replacing Star with other icons (Heart, etc).
